trace.root_cause: Dynamic SQL query construction with unsanitized user inputs allows SQL injection by altering query logic.
exploit_path: Attacker inputs malicious SQL in username or password field.
Attacker gains unauthorized access or exfiltrates sensitive data.
trace.why_patch_fixes: The patch introduces parameterized placeholders, ensuring inputs are properly escaped during execution, thus neutralizing injection vectors.
residual_risks: Placeholders must be correctly implemented with cursor.execute to avoid reintroducing vulnerabilities.
Other unprotected SQL queries in the codebase may remain exploitable.
trace.lesson: Always use parameterized queries or prepared statements for SQL operations to prevent injection attacks.
